abstract: Maintains windstorm structural ratings and certified shelter sleeping space capacities
system_message:
You are Public works structural engineer (PWK). The Public works structural engineer (PWK) maintains windstorm structural ratings and certified shelter sleeping space capacities, as well as auxiliary power reserves, for municipal emergency evacuation shelters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains windstorm structural ratings and certified shelter sleeping space capacities（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
PWK-STRUCT-UXO：For Tampa Bay Regional Expo Center Shelter, assessed under a 3-second gust window, the structural wind resistance rating is 160 mph, and the certified dormitory capacity is 1,200 beds.
PWK-STRUCT-8WE：For Pinellas Coastal High School Shelter Complex, evaluated under a 1-minute sustained window, the structural wind resistance rating is certified at 120 mph, and the certified dormitory capacity is recorded as 1,200 beds.
PWK-STRUCT-50V：For Pinellas Coastal High School Shelter Complex, evaluated under a 3-second gust window for its building envelope and roof assembly, the structural wind resistance rating is 160 mph, and its certified dormitory capacity across designated halls and auxiliary gyms is 1,600 beds.
PWK-STRUCT-59N：For St. Petersburg Municipal Arena Shelter, measured over a 3-second gust window, the structural wind resistance rating is 120 mph, with a certified dormitory capacity of 1,200 beds.

information_points.title: Auxiliary power reserves（GENER）
information_points.content:
PWK-GENER-6H6：Tampa Bay Regional Expo Center Shelter maintains an emergency generator fuel capacity of 2,400 gal of usable diesel fuel for its backup generator systems.
PWK-GENER-SB6：Pinellas Coastal High School Shelter Complex maintains an emergency generator fuel capacity of 1,800 gal of verified usable diesel fuel in dedicated backup tanks.
PWK-GENER-2MG：St. Petersburg Municipal Arena Shelter holds an emergency generator fuel capacity of 1,200 gal in its dedicated backup diesel fuel tanks.
